patch.summary: Mailchimp cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Mailchimp pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. 14-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: Mailchimp plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: contact management, lead management, pipeline management · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Essentials
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: workflow automation, sales automation · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Standard
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: AI assistance · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Premium
lines.description: Trial available · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.heading: Mailchimp cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Mailchimp against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (workflow automation (Essentials, Standard, Premium)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (contact management, lead management, pipeline management) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Marketing-led CRM — not a full sales pipeline platform. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
